tasks.title: Standard 0.7.1 contract additions: task.security_review_verdict field + state-machine annotations + TypeScript types
definition_of_done: standard/schemas/task.schema.json gains an optional `security_review_verdict` property of type [string, null] with enum ["pass", "bounce", "escalate", null] and default null; not added to required[].

standard/state-machines/task.json carries `security_gate: true` on exactly three transitions out of automated-gates: → ui-review (full_pipeline), → qa (full_pipeline), → merged (fast_lane). No other transitions carry the flag.
standard/state-machines/task.json carries `resets_security_verdict: true` on the review → automated-gates transition. No other transition carries this flag.

standard/validators/types.ts: Task interface extended with optional `security_review_verdict?: 'pass' | 'bounce' | 'escalate' | null` and `security_class?: 'low' | 'high'` (if not already present from 0.8.0).
standard/validators/types.ts: StatusTransitions transitions[] item type extended with optional `security_gate?: boolean` and `resets_security_verdict?: boolean`.
standard/conformance/tests/task.test.ts extended with coverage of the new field (accepts pass/bounce/escalate/null, accepts absent, rejects invalid values).

standard/conformance/tests/status-transitions.test.ts extended with a state-machine schema sanity test verifying the four annotations land on exactly the four named transitions (typo detector for `security_gate` / `resets_security_verdict`).
Full standard conformance suite passes (`cd standard && npm run build && npm test`) with the new tests green and no pre-existing regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Loading `standard/schemas/task.schema.json` and validating a Task fixture with security_review_verdict="pass" returns true; with security_review_verdict="approved" returns false.
Reading `standard/state-machines/task.json` and filtering for transitions with security_gate===true yields exactly three entries matching the (from=automated-gates, to∈{ui-review,qa,merged}) triple.
Reading the same state-machine and filtering for resets_security_verdict===true yields exactly one entry (review → automated-gates).
`tsc --noEmit` over standard/ succeeds — the new optional Task fields and the extended StatusTransitions transitions[] item type compile without errors.
Standard conformance suite count after this task: ~124 baseline + ~6 new field-coverage cases + ~4 new state-machine sanity cases ≈ 134+, with zero failures.

tasks.title: Standard 0.7.1: validateSecurityGate validator + conformance tests + fixture + version bump
definition_of_done: standard/validators/security-gate.ts created, exporting `validateSecurityGate(event, stateMachine, workItem): ValidationResult`. Signature matches the existing `validateStatusTransitionLegality` shape. Behavior per spec §2: early-exits ok for non-task work items, for transitions without security_gate, and for tasks whose security_class !== 'high'; returns ok when security_review_verdict === 'pass'; otherwise returns { ok:false, violations:[{ rule:'security-gate', severity:'error', message:..., workItemId:... }] } with the canonical message naming the transition, current values, and the recovery action 'Advance to security-review first.'
standard/validators/index.ts exports `validateSecurityGate` alongside the existing validator exports.

standard/conformance/tests/validator-security-gate.test.ts created and covers the full 2×4 matrix on each of the three flagged transitions (low×{null,pass,bounce,escalate} all legal; high×{null,bounce,escalate} illegal; high×pass legal), the control matrix on non-flagged transitions (high×null legal for automated-gates → implementing, → escalated, → security-review), and edge cases (non-task work item legal; transition not found in state machine legal).

standard/conformance/fixtures/task-security-high-verdict-pass.json created with security_class='high' and security_review_verdict='pass', a unique id distinct from existing fixtures, and matching the shape of the existing task-security-high.json fixture.

standard/conformance/tests/security-fixture.test.ts extended to validate the new fixture and to assert the verdict-reset post-condition (a task in automated-gates after a review→automated-gates transition must validate with security_review_verdict=null).

standard/CHANGELOG.md gets a new top entry `## 0.7.1 — 2026-05-26` with the canonical 'stricter conformance' phrasing per the spec §7, an Added section listing the field, annotations, and validator, and a Migration section.
standard/VERSION bumped from 0.7.0 to 0.7.1.
standard/package.json `version` field bumped from 0.7.0 to 0.7.1.
Full standard conformance suite passes (`cd standard && npm run build && npm test`) — ~124 baseline + ~12 new ≈ 136+ tests, zero failures.
acceptance_criteria: Invoking validateSecurityGate with a status_transition event for automated-gates → merged on a task with security_class='high' and security_review_verdict=null returns ok:false with violations[0].rule === 'security-gate' and a message matching /security_review_verdict.*pass/ AND /security_class.*high/ AND /Advance to security-review first/.
Invoking validateSecurityGate with the same event on a task with security_class='high' and security_review_verdict='pass' returns ok:true.
Invoking validateSecurityGate on automated-gates → implementing with security_class='high' and security_review_verdict=null returns ok:true (control: non-flagged transition).
Reading standard/conformance/fixtures/task-security-high-verdict-pass.json and validating it against task.schema.json returns true.

`cat standard/VERSION` outputs 0.7.1; `node -p "require('./standard/package.json').version"` outputs 0.7.1; standard/CHANGELOG.md head contains the literal phrase 'Stricter conformance' and references 'security_class=high'.
Full conformance suite after the bump produces a green run with no skipped tests.

tasks.title: reference-impl: TaskDoc.security_review_verdict + classifyTaskSecurity helper refactor + wire validateSecurityGate into advanceWorkItemStatus
definition_of_done: reference-impl/lib/task.ts: TaskDoc interface extended with optional `security_review_verdict?: 'pass' | 'bounce' | 'escalate' | null` (and `security_class?: 'low' | 'high'` if not already present from 0.8.0). Load/save round-trip preserves the field, including the null value distinct from absent.

reference-impl/lib/security-classify.ts: new exported helper `classifyTaskSecurity(repoRoot, taskId, opts?: { branch?: string; changedFiles?: string[] }): SecurityClassification`. Composes loadTask + git diff against the task's feature branch (default `cloverleaf/<taskId>`) + computeSecurityClassification + loadSecurityPathsConfig. Supports `changedFiles` injection as a testing seam. Git invocation errors return an empty changed-file list (the caller decides fail-toward-review).

reference-impl/lib/cli.ts: the existing `classify-security` subcommand handler refactored to call `classifyTaskSecurity` rather than inlining git+computeSecurityClassification. Behavior — argv shape, stdout JSON, exit code, --branch flag — is unchanged from the user's perspective.

reference-impl/lib/work-item.ts: `advanceWorkItemStatus` imports `validateSecurityGate` from @cloverleaf/standard/validators/index.js and invokes it after the existing `validateStatusTransitionLegality` check, gated on workItemType === 'task'. On security-gate failure, throws an Error whose `.code === 'SECURITY_GATE'` and whose message is the validator's violation message (no 'Illegal transition:' prefix).

The validator is invoked with the same workItemForValidator shape passed to validateStatusTransitionLegality. The Task fixture passed in carries security_class and security_review_verdict so the validator can read them.

reference-impl/tests/cli.test.ts gains coverage of the wiring: advance-status refuses automated-gates → ui-review on high+null with a 'security-gate' error; allows it on high+pass and low+null; allows automated-gates → implementing (unconditional escape hatch) even on high+null.

reference-impl/tests/security-classify.test.ts gains coverage of classifyTaskSecurity: declared=low + injected sensitive file → effective='high', diff_detected=true; declared=low + injected benign file → effective='low'; declared='high' + any file list → effective='high'.
Full reference-impl unit suite passes (`cd reference-impl && npm test`) — no regressions; ~4 new wiring tests + ~3 new helper tests.
acceptance_criteria: saveTask + loadTask round-trip preserves security_review_verdict='pass' verbatim; preserves security_review_verdict=null distinct from an absent property when applicable.
Calling classifyTaskSecurity(repoRoot, taskId, { changedFiles: ['engine/exchange.py'] }) on a task with security_class='low' returns { declared:'low', diff_detected:true, effective:'high', ... }.

Calling advanceStatus on a task with status='automated-gates', security_class='high', security_review_verdict=null with toStatus='ui-review' throws an Error matching /security-gate/ whose .code === 'SECURITY_GATE'.
Calling the same with security_review_verdict='pass' completes successfully; loadTask shows status='ui-review'.
Calling advanceStatus with toStatus='implementing' on the same high+null task completes successfully (unconditional escape hatch preserved).
Existing `cloverleaf-cli classify-security <repoRoot> <taskId>` CLI invocation continues to emit the same JSON envelope it did before the refactor (argv, stdout, exit code unchanged).

tasks.title: reference-impl: classify-security writeback + verdict-reset in advanceStatus
definition_of_done: reference-impl/lib/task.ts: `advanceStatus` inspects the target transition. When `transition.security_gate === true`: (1) calls classifyTaskSecurity; (2) on classify-security exception, surfaces a stderr warning and treats effective='high' (fail-toward-review per spec §5); (3) when declared='low' and effective='high', writes back `security_class='high'`, persists to disk, commits with message `cloverleaf: <ID> security_class → high (diff-detected)`, and mutates the in-memory task so the downstream validator reads the high value.

reference-impl/lib/task.ts: `advanceStatus` when `transition.resets_security_verdict === true` writes `security_review_verdict: null` into the persisted task atomically with the status change. Commit message form: `cloverleaf: <ID> status review → automated-gates; security_review_verdict → null (rework)`.

reference-impl/lib/security-classify.ts: testing seam exposed — `__setMockChangedFiles(files: string[] | null)` — used only by tests. classifyTaskSecurity consults the mock first when set, then opts.changedFiles, then git.

reference-impl/tests/cli.test.ts: new `advance-status: classify-security writeback` block — declared='low' + sensitive mocked diff on a guarded transition → writeback fires (reload shows security_class='high') AND validator subsequently refuses (high+null); declared='low' + benign mocked diff → no writeback, advance succeeds.

reference-impl/tests/cli.test.ts: new `advance-status: verdict reset on review → automated-gates` block — resets pass to null; idempotent on null; does NOT reset on transitions without the flag (e.g. security-review → automated-gates).
Full reference-impl unit suite passes (`cd reference-impl && npm test`) — no regressions; ~5 new tests across writeback + reset.
acceptance_criteria: Calling advanceStatus on a task {status:'automated-gates', security_class:'low', security_review_verdict:null} with mock changedFiles=['engine/exchange.py'] and toStatus='ui-review' throws a SECURITY_GATE error AND a fresh loadTask shows security_class='high'.

Calling advanceStatus on a task {status:'automated-gates', security_class:'low', security_review_verdict:null} with mock changedFiles=['README.md'] and toStatus='ui-review' completes successfully; loadTask shows status='ui-review' and security_class still 'low'.

Calling advanceStatus from status='review' to toStatus='automated-gates' on a task with security_review_verdict='pass' completes successfully; loadTask shows security_review_verdict===null and status='automated-gates'. Git log shows a single commit whose message contains both 'status review → automated-gates' and 'security_review_verdict → null'.

Calling advanceStatus from status='security-review' to toStatus='automated-gates' on a task with security_review_verdict='pass' does NOT reset the verdict — loadTask still shows security_review_verdict='pass'.

When classifyTaskSecurity is forced to throw (e.g. broken git repo), advance-status emits a stderr line containing 'classify-security' AND 'high', and the validator subsequently refuses the guarded transition for a class=null/low task.

tasks.title: reference-impl: CLI exit-code 2 routing for SECURITY_GATE + set-task-field subcommand
definition_of_done: reference-impl/lib/cli.ts: the advance-status (or generic) catch block recognizes errors with `.code === 'SECURITY_GATE'`. For these errors it writes the bare validator message to stderr (no 'Illegal transition:' prefix, no 'Error:' prefix) and exits process with code 2. Generic illegal-transition errors continue to exit with the existing code (typically 1) via the existing path.

reference-impl/lib/cli.ts: new subcommand `set-task-field <repoRoot> <taskId> <field> <value>`. Loads the task, mutates the named field, saves. Field allowlist is a Set scoped initially to {'security_review_verdict'}; unknown fields exit with a clear error (non-zero exit code per existing die() convention) listing the allowed fields. The literal string 'null' is parsed to JSON null; other values are stored verbatim.
reference-impl/lib/cli.ts: usage() help string mentions `set-task-field <repoRoot> <taskId> <field> <value>`.

reference-impl/tests/cli.test.ts: new `CLI advance-status: security-gate refusal exit code` block — invoking the CLI binary (via execSync or matching the file's existing CLI test pattern) on a high+null task attempting a guarded transition exits with code 2 and a stderr matching /security_review_verdict.*pass/ and /Advance to security-review first/.

tasks.title: reference-impl: integration tests for Flows 1–4 + backward-compat (includes the load-bearing Flow 2 dogfood reproduction)
definition_of_done: reference-impl/tests/integration.security-gate.test.ts created. Each describe block drives the full CLI surface (advance-status, set-task-field) end-to-end against a temp repo; no LLM subagent involvement; uses the __setMockChangedFiles seam from CLV-104 to inject diffs deterministically.
Flow 1 — clean two-pass — covered: high task, null verdict, advance to security-review, set verdict pass, advance back to automated-gates, advance forward (ui-review) succeeds.

Flow 2 — under-classification at the door (THE LOAD-BEARING DOGFOOD REPRODUCTION) — covered: low-declared task with mocked sensitive diff attempts fast-lane merge directly; CLI exits 2 with security-gate refusal; the writeback fired (security_class is now 'high' on reload); the recover sequence (advance to security-review → set verdict pass → advance to automated-gates → retry merge) succeeds and the task ends at status='merged'.
Flow 3 — rework reset — covered: high task with verdict='pass' at status='review' advances to automated-gates and the verdict resets to null; the subsequent guarded advance refuses with exit 2.
Flow 4 — blocker → escalated — covered: set verdict='escalate' from status='security-review', advance to escalated; final state is terminal and the guard is never invoked.

Backward-compat — covered: a task whose security_review_verdict property is fully absent (simulating a 0.8.0-era task) is treated as null on read; review → automated-gates writes null explicitly via the reset; the subsequent guarded advance for a high-class task refuses.
Both build chains pass before the test run: `cd standard && npm run build` (provides validateSecurityGate + types to reference-impl via the workspace link) AND `cd reference-impl && npm run build`.
`cd reference-impl && npm test` reports zero failures with the five new integration tests green; full suite count ≈ baseline + total unit/integration adds from CLV-103…CLV-107.
acceptance_criteria: Flow 1 test passes: a high-class task with verdict null traverses security-review → automated-gates → ui-review and the final loadTask shows status='ui-review' and security_review_verdict='pass'.

Flow 2 test passes (LOAD-BEARING): the initial advance from automated-gates → merged on a low-declared task with mocked sensitive diff exits with code 2 AND the post-refusal loadTask shows security_class='high' (writeback fired despite refusal). The recovery sequence completes; final loadTask shows status='merged' and security_review_verdict='pass'. The reproduced audit trail (state events, focused commits, feedback envelope written via the skill) matches the shape of the Flow 1 trail per spec §4.
Flow 3 test passes: after review → automated-gates on a verdict='pass' task, loadTask shows security_review_verdict===null; the immediately-following advance to ui-review exits 2.
Flow 4 test passes: after the advance to escalated, loadTask shows status='escalated' and security_review_verdict='escalate'; no subsequent guard-firing.

Backward-compat test passes: a task created without security_review_verdict in its JSON file has the field set to null by the first review → automated-gates reset; the subsequent guarded advance refuses with exit 2.
